title: Whisker
html:
Whisker Broodling

Race: Whisker

Class: Fighter


There are two types of whiskers. The normal adult types and the smaller but ferocious young of the rat-like whiskers, known as Brood or Broodling. Both are essentially the same type of creatures, cute but in tasmanian devil sort of way.

Tip: Broodlings are easy for a mage with an AoE spell. They can be harder for fighters or rangers. A fighter is wise to acquire Cleave early and use it to deal with them. A Ranger will have to pick them off in succession, but at least does not have to run after them.

Basic Types

Name Element Habitat
Brood and Broodlings
Whisker Ratling None Dew Valley Forest
Whisker Broodling None Lower levels of Algernon, Ratsputin's Gulag.
Flame Brood Fire Vergrim's Vexation
Divine Brood Divine Vegrim's Vexation
Poison Whisker Broodling Poison Algernon, Widower's Nest
Whiskers
Poison Whisker Poison Widower's Nest
Hood Rat Poison Dingbat Duhrill's Pad
Ice Whisker Ice Ratsputin's Gulag
Fizz Star-Soaked Whisker Poison Squeakeasys off of Algernon

Uniques

  • The Particularly Rude Broodling is a larger and stronger Whisker Broodling who is found on Level 1 of Algernon. Killing him opens the door to Sir Kent the Artisan who is a quest-giver. Sometimes the Particularly Rude Broodling is near the door but sometimes it is not.
  • Dew Valley Rattle Tooth is a Champion whose lair is located off level 3 of Dew Valley.

Specials

  • Seer Brood - Are Flame Brood spawned in groups by Vergrim in the Lair of Vergrim. They are slightly faster and stronger then other whiskers and when near death, they perform a self-destruct attack causing Fire Damage that can knock you down for 3 to 5 seconds.
  • Vergrim's Brood are lesser versions of the Seer Brood. One of them will suddenly appear among a group of Flame Brood in the levels of Vergrim's Vexation, and explode when near death, but with much less damage than Seer Brood.
  • Whisker Prospectors and Whisker Flingers are found in the mines of Algernon.
